owner_scope: Issue #301 comment5573256033; supersedes the former sole-cleanup whitelist

override_schema.mode: astra-all (the only mode; null/absent means no override)
override_schema.reason: why the owner narrowed routing, in one line
override_schema.set_by: who set it (owner, or the session acting on the owner's briefing)
override_schema.expires: optional ISO-8601 timestamp with offset; past means inactive
override_schema.semantics: Narrows every role and job class to hard_model. It may only narrow toward the hard model and may NEVER lower effort. Mid-run the same mode is written to $MIPSTARRE_CACHE_ROOT/watchdog/model-override, which takes precedence and needs no PR. Rows dispatched while it is active carry override_mode/override_source and are excluded from the Sol:Astra ratio rather than read as violations.
